title: EliteChel Media | LGCHL Playoff Night in Review
subtitle: Monday, November 16, 2026 · Season 55, Round 1
intro:
Verified final scores from public.lgchl_games after the November 16 manual delta sync: 24 completed games, 142 total goals, three overtimes, one shutout. Twenty-four games belong to the 12 confirmed first-round series; four other scheduled QMJHL games remain unresolved and are excluded.

Individual Nov 16 game box scores and player lines have not been imported. No player scoring, goal order, shots, assists, saves or three-star selections are inferred. Links point to the LeagueGaming game pages.
threeStars: Individual player data for Monday's playoff games has not been verified. Three Stars will remain unassigned until reliable box-score lines are available.
